_note: Three ways of grieving. On first launch the player picks the quote that speaks to them; from then on the app shows quotes in that style. 'for' lists the toolkit cards a quote fits best ('any' fits everywhere).

styles.label: Let it hurt
styles.description: Feelings pass when you let them in.

styles.label: It gets better
styles.description: This isn't forever, and you'll come out stronger.

styles.label: Keep walking
styles.description: Get up, take one step, then the next.

ui.title: Which one speaks to you?
ui.intro: Not everyone grieves the same way. Pick the one that feels right today. The app will show you more like it, and you can change it any time in the menu.

quotes.text: Let everything happen to you: beauty and terror. Just keep going. No feeling is final.
The best way out is always through.
Grief is just love with no place to go.
What we have once enjoyed we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
No one ever told me that grief felt so like fear.
There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power.
The world breaks everyone and afterward many are strong at the broken places.
There is a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
Nothing is permanent in this wicked world, not even our troubles.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
You can't stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
